Itail=30 uA with Cc=1.2 pF gives gm1≈210 uS and GBW≈28 MHz. I6=120 uA gives gm6≈1.2 mS, about 2.8·gm1·CL/Cc, and Rz cancels the RHP zero. The long-L tail sets CMRR. PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "itail": (30e-6, 15e-6, 80e-6),  # tail current
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror + M6 gm/Id (same for zero systematic offset)
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror + M6 L
    "i6":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),# 2nd stage current
    "gmidb": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # NMOS bias/tail/sink gm/Id
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # NMOS bias L
    "cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (0.9, 0.4, 2.0),        # Rz = rzk*(CL+Cc)/(gm6*Cc)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    i1 = p["itail"] / 2
    cc = p["cc"]

    # NMOS bias chain (same gmid / L -> clean ratios)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    # input pair; source sits ~0.2 V above ground
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.1)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], p["itail"], vds=vtail)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.8)
    # second stage
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], p["i6"], vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], p["i6"], vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] * (cl + cc) / (m6.gm * cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # first stage (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (1.0 / m6.gm - rz)) if abs(1.0 / m6.gm - rz) > 1e-9 else 1e30
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) / 2
    if fz > 0:   # LHP zero (rz > 1/gm6) adds phase
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    else:
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    pm = min(pm, 89)

    slew = min(p["itail"] / cc, p["i6"] / (cl + cc))
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau * 1.3

    rtail = 1.0 / mt.gds
    cmrr = 2 * m1.gm * m3.gm * rtail / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    cmrr_db = db(cmrr)

    k = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = math.sqrt(16 * k / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = th * 8   # flicker-dominated estimate at 1 kHz

    power = vdd * (iref + p["itail"] + p["i6"])
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "slew": slew, "power": power}
